arguments.value: Use HTB with one root class at 100mbit, then create per-client leaf classes and classify each client’s traffic into its own class using iptables marks or tc filters. Give every client a guaranteed 10mbit rate and a higher ceil up to 100mbit, so a single client can use all bandwidth when alone, while multiple active clients share the link fairly and each can drop to about 100/N Mbps when N clients are active. Since tc cannot automatically know how many downloading clients exist, you must manage the client classes dynamically; for equal sharing with dynamic flows, fq_codel or cake is often a better fit than trying to do it all with HTB alone.
